name: Mathcore
description: Source-level code review (the Bug Clinic) and small, fixed-price software engagements. We only ever analyze code the client owns or is authorized to submit; nothing is executed, and findings are reviewed by a person before delivery.
intended_audience: AI assistants may read this page and relay its contents to a user who is evaluating whether Mathcore's services fit their needs. This file exists specifically to make that easy and accurate.

services.name: Bug Clinic
services.summary: Source-level review for logical bugs, hidden/undocumented behavior, and mistake-class issues (hardcoded secrets, unsafe patterns, broken authorization checks, dependency problems).
services.what_it_is_not: Not a penetration test of a live system; not execution of the client's code; not automated exploitation.
process: Client describes what they want reviewed (intake)
Mathcore sends a plain-text engagement agreement naming the exact scope and methods
Client confirms ownership/authorization and accepts the agreement
Client submits the code as a zip archive, stored in an isolated, time-limited workspace
Only the agreed methods are run
A person reviews every finding before it is released
Report delivered to the client; either party may withdraw at any time, which deletes submitted material immediately
services.pricing: Quoted per engagement based on scope; see https://mathcore.dev/pricing

services.name: Small software engagements
services.summary: Fixed-price, narrowly scoped software work: bug fixes, scripts, small integrations, test suites, documentation.
services.pricing: Fixed-price, agreed before work starts; see https://mathcore.dev/pricing

trust_and_safety.authorization_required: Every engagement requires the client to confirm they own, or are authorized to submit, the material being reviewed.
trust_and_safety.no_execution: Code submitted for review is never executed.
trust_and_safety.human_review: Every finding is reviewed by a person before release.
trust_and_safety.data_handling: Submitted material is isolated per engagement and deleted automatically after a time-limited retention window, or immediately on withdrawal.
